svg.desc: System FMEA failure chains, sheet 7 of 8 (SFM rev 0.38): failure modes SFM-029 to SFM-031 (3 failure modes, 14 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-2 · System FMEA failure chains — sheet 7 of 8
SFM rev 0.38 · BL-007 · draft · SFM-029 … SFM-031 · 14 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
commands in magnitude and rate; detect
End effect: Any upstream fault can produce SFM-002 / SFM-008
Wrong safety model or parameter set for this car
Safety model limit defect in firmware
Harness allows the device to reach a bus without passing the panda
The panda 100 Hz safety task stops or is starved (defect, interrupt
storm, peripheral lock-up), so the RX timeout, heartbeat and
TX-arrival checks are not run and no siren is raised. A stopped tas…
Actuation frames reach the panda faster than nominal (a backlog
forwarded back-to-back, or a burst): each frame is within the limits,
but the limits apply per frame, not per time. The reference build…
An approved frame is altered after the TX check: in the copy into
FDCAN message RAM, the message RAM, the FDCAN core or the
transceiver. The packet XOR catches a change in the software…
A corrupted SoC-to-MCU SPI transfer passes the 8-bit XOR, so a
wrong CAN frame or a wrong control command (safety mode,
parameter) is taken. The TX limits still apply to frames; nothing…
Safety state in panda SRAM (controls_allowed, limits, counters)
corrupted: a soft error or permanent fault with no ECC handling
(TSR-503, TSR-507; GAP-08), or a wrong-address write by the SPI…
The panda time base fails or drifts (HSE crystal, PLL). A lost HSE
is caught by the clock security system, which resets the MCU
(clock.h:118-119); a drift is not detected, so every timeout and rat…
The panda MCU runs in the brown-out zone during a supply dip
(BOR level not set, PVD not enabled); the supply voltage is only
Calibrated pose wrong (calibration or IMU fault)
device_motion_valid gate blocks detection when aEgo and IMU
End effect: Unneeded handback to the driver

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
